connector.name: Schemacrawler Ai
connector.registryDescription: Enables natural language schema queries - explore tables, keys, procedures, and get SQL help fast
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image schemacrawler-ai:17.12.2-1. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the schemacrawler account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SCHCRWLR_MCP_SERVER_TRANSPORT
env.description: MCP Server transport type - valid values are 'http' or 'stdio', defaulting to 'stdio'.

env.name: SCHCRWLR_DATABASE_USER
env.description: Database user name. Can be optional depending on the database connection type.

env.name: SCHCRWLR_DATABASE_PASSWORD
env.description: Database user password. Can be optional depending on the database connection type.

env.name: SCHCRWLR_JDBC_URL
env.description: JDBC URL for database connection. If this is provided, the server, host, port and database are not used.

env.name: SCHCRWLR_SERVER
env.description: SchemaCrawler database plugin, for example, 'sqlserver' or 'sqlite'. Used only if the JDBC URL is not provided.

env.name: SCHCRWLR_HOST
env.description: Database host. Defaults to localhost. Used only if the JDBC URL is not provided.

env.name: SCHCRWLR_PORT
env.description: Database port. Defaults to the default port for the server type. Used only if the JDBC URL is not provided.

env.name: SCHCRWLR_DATABASE
env.description: Database to connect to (optional). Used only if the JDBC URL is not provided.

env.name: SCHCRWLR_INFO_LEVEL
env.description: How much database metadata to retrieve. Values are 'minimum', 'standard', 'detailed' or 'maximum'.

env.name: SCHCRWLR_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Logging verbosity level. Values are 'SEVERE', 'WARNING', 'INFO', 'CONFIG', or 'FINE'.

env.name: SCHCRWLR_EXCLUDE_TOOLS
env.description: MCP Server tools to exclude, as a comma-separated list.
